verdict.rationale: Airweave is open-source and self-hostable (docs-11, docs-17) and exposes a documented OpenAPI/CLI interface (probe-2, probe-4, docs-6, docs-14) that lets you query synced data programmatically, which mitigates lock-in, but there is no explicit bulk-export or backup feature described for extracting all synced 'memories' in a machine-readable dump. missing for 10: an explicit export/backup API or CLI command producing a portable machine-readable dump of the full memory store, documentation on migrating data out of Airweave, independent confirmation that self-hosted data can be fully extracted.
